visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short black hair, wearing a vibrant blue scarf and sunglasses perched on her head, stands in front of a red Coca-Cola vending machine. She smiles cheerfully at the camera while the machine's bright inventory of various bottled beverages is clearly visible behind her in the natural outdoor light. (2) The camera transitions to a wide panning shot of a serene winter landscape. Thick layers of white snow cover the ground and the low-lying shrubs. Tall, slender evergreen trees stand in the background under a clear, bright sky, creating a peaceful and cold atmospheric setting. (3) The woman is now holding a white disposable cup, presumably containing a warm drink, as she gazes curiously at a large, rounded bank of snow. Her facial expression shows deep concentration and intrigue as she attempts to identify a specific sound mentioned by the off-screen narrator. (4) A close-up shot focuses on the detailed texture of the accumulated snow. A red and white traffic cone is partially submerged in the white drifts, and the surrounding environment consists of a corrugated metal wall and a few bare tree branches reaching out from the snow. (5) The woman leans her head down closely toward the snowbank, performing a listening gesture. She wears a beige quilted puffer jacket that blends with the winter environment. Her body language is playful and engaged as she participates in the sensory experiment of hearing melting snow. (6) Upon realizing the source of the sound, the woman stands up and bursts into energetic laughter. She looks directly into the lens, her eyes squinting with joy. The background reveals a simple grey industrial building and more patches of snow on the asphalt ground. (7) The camera tilts upwards to capture the edge of a building's roof. Long, sharp icicles hang from the gutter, and droplets of water are clearly seen falling from the melting ice. This visual evidence confirms the woman's suspicion that the sound was actually dripping water.
